about: Attacks an enemy lord or army; if it slips out of view, goes to where it was last seen. It gives up a chase that has not closed in for 8 hours (a target as fast as the lord is caught only when it stops), and its next order, if any, starts.

when.poke: {target} is gone (beaten, captured or broken up).
{me} gave up the chase of {target}: no closer in 8 hours ({distance(me, target)} away), so {target} is as fast as {me} or faster.

search.about: looking for {target} where it was last seen

when.poke: {target} is gone (beaten, captured or broken up).
